name: Magma Spray
body:
School evocation [earth, fire]; Level: magus 5, sorcerer/wizard 5

Components: V, S,M/DF (a piece of volcanic rock)

Casting Time: 1 standard action

Range: 40 ft.

Area: Cone-shaped burst

Duration: Instantaneous

Saving Throw: Reflex half; Spell Resistance: yes

A cone of magma and molten rocks shoots from your fingertips. Any creature in the area of the takes 1d6 points of damage per caster level (maximum 12d6), half of which is fire damage and half of which is bludgeoning. A successful Reflex saves halves the damage. Flammable materials ignite if the magma touches them, as if hit by burning oil. A character can extinguish burning items as a full-round action.
